test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 7 July 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'DELHI' is written as 'CDKGH', 'NERVOUS' is written as 'MDQUNTR' and 'SURE' is written as 'RTQD'. What is the code for the word 'MILLION' in that code language?
solution:
The position of the English alphabet letters is given below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/af7f5248a0c6050307cf17b8c83db8e491536f519fe8ba8a2eb262575c9e9f06.png] 

'DELHI' is written as 'CDKGH'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3627e0e6e43c1a4dd0bf9d2c7ef4989f226fb483f970466b1898c387fe94c4ba.png] 

And,

'NERVOUS' is written as 'MDQUNTR'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7248ac1eeeeff3418e83afb71e11d91b5cf99fe826e323479ed593c9e354f876.png] 

And,

'SURE' is written as 'RTQD'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7d35949d58561ef23becef50821b1dd5ebd362d07219ca250e74c4ff055dac7d.png] 

Similarly,

'MILLION' in that code '?'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a280e730634411925e7a6c3c7a585f6d257e7398002cce27116ff15e7c4e3b00.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"LHKKHNM".**
